candidateIdentity.variantName: Silver-tone stainless steel bracelet, grey dial

sourceChecks.note: The exact official UK page independently validates reference 98B316, its current £679 Add to Bag offer, stainless-steel case and bracelet, fold-over clasp with safety and extender, rounded 46 mm case measurement, proprietary Precisionist movement, curved mineral crystal, chronograph, date, and 300 m water resistance. It does not publish thickness, lug-to-lug, full weight, numerical accuracy, graded lume, or the bracelet-to-case interface.

Bulova's exact Canadian page independently corroborates the identity and NN50 high-performance Precisionist quartz movement while publishing the more precise 46.5 mm case width, 24 mm lug width, luminous hands and markers, and 300 m rating. Its separate sold-out Canadian offer is not mixed into the reviewed UK price snapshot. A verified buyer says the glow could last longer, but supplies no charge protocol, elapsed time, or legibility standard.

Citizen Watch Group's exact-model service lookup identifies Icon 98B316 and lists its Band and Spring Bar as separate available replacement parts. This directly establishes the factory bracelet-to-case interface as spring_bar.

Bulova's official Precisionist collection states that the proprietary 262 kHz movement is accurate to plus or minus 10 seconds per year. The exact Canadian page identifies 98B316's NN50 as that Precisionist high-performance quartz mechanism.
Costco's exact-model listing supplies a 17.5 mm case thickness. It is used only for the missing dimension, not for price, availability, or any unsupported fit estimate.

The exact-reference specification identifies a 54.5 mm case length, 46.5 mm case width, 17.5 mm thickness, and 24 mm lug space. The latter three values match Bulova and Costco, supporting case length as the otherwise unpublished lug-to-lug dimension.
The exact-reference retailer independently lists the same 17.5 x 46.5 x 54.5 dimensional set. A separate exact-reference specialist reports 54.6 mm case length, consistent after normal rounding.

The exact-reference specialist reports a 54.6 mm case length, corroborating the independent 54.5 mm records after rounding. Its 276 g weight does not resolve the separate 274 g full-watch records or the approximately 270 g sized-bracelet report.

The exact SKU and EAN specification reports 274 g, but another exact specialist reports 276 g and an owner review reports approximately 270 g depending on bracelet sizing. Full configured weight remains open rather than selecting the most common value.

The exact-reference owner review reports approximately 270 g depending on links removed and calls ambient-light lume unusably weak. The configuration-specific weight cannot establish full-length weight, and a separate exact hands-on account describes the lume as usable, so neither gap is normalized.

Retrieved 2026-08-30 through a narrow Perplexity source-discovery pass as an exact-reference retailer record publishing 170 g. Independent retrieval did not expose a reviewable methodology or bracelet configuration, and the value sharply conflicts with the existing 270-276 g measurements.

The exact product listing exposes a 14.11 oz item-weight field, approximately 400 g, but does not establish bare-watch weighing or exclude packaging and listing-level shipping data. It conflicts with every hands-on watch measurement and cannot support weightFullG.

The exact-reference specialist article identifies lume-tipped hour and minute hands but supplies no charging method, brightness comparison, decay interval, or nighttime legibility result. It proves application location only.

This exact-reference hands-on article reports 274 g and describes the luminous hands and markers as readable after light exposure but not especially bright. It does not document bracelet length, weighing equipment or protocol, charge intensity, elapsed decay, or a repeatable legibility comparison, so neither weightFullG nor lumeGrade is promoted. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

The exact-reference retailer record reports 229 g and 12.40 mm thickness while the exact primary/secondary dimensional set converges on 17.5 mm thickness and the hands-on weight set spans 270-276 g. Its luminous-hands/numerals prose has no charge or timed-decay protocol. The conflicting dimensions and unscoped mass cannot be merged into the reviewed configuration. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

This exact-reference owner video/article reports approximately 262 g with all links, 251 g after removing three links, and roughly 53 mm lug-to-lug, while the independent dimensional set converges on 54.5-54.6 mm and the full-watch records span 270-276 g. Its description of very weak lume is subjective and supplies no charge or timed-decay protocol. The conflicting fit and unscoped mass cannot be merged into the reviewed configuration. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

note: Keep as research-only. This exact replacement satisfies the intended attainable price band, and primary sources resolve its homogeneous UK offer, precise diameter, lug width, movement identity, annual accuracy, and factory spring-bar interface. Independent dimensional sets converge on 54.5-54.6 mm lug-to-lug. A source-led pass widened the weight conflict to 170 g, approximately 270 g after bracelet sizing, 274 g, 276 g, an approximately 400 g item-weight field, and a newly found 229 g retailer record whose dimensions also conflict with the exact current configuration; no value documents a complete factory-length bracelet and bare-watch weighing protocol. Exact lume evidence ranges from short-lived or unusably weak to usable or merely readable after light exposure, without controlled charge or elapsed-time observations. Weight and lume remain null.
